verdict.rationale: Lorikeet documents an official MCP server, so this axis applies, but nothing in the evidence describes issuing scoped or least-privilege API keys or tokens for an external agent. The closest item, "workflow-scoped tool access", restricts which tools Lorikeet's own support agent can call inside workflows. That is an adjacent guardrail, not credential issuance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
